answer: Each identity must pass a fresh interactive proof-of-humanity challenge every epoch, expiring after ten minutes, so challenges cannot be stockpiled. A farm pays a solving service about $1 per challenge per identity, so 1,000 fakes cost $1,000 every epoch. The meadow of cheap clones withers: each fake adds a dollar per epoch forever, the tundra gets harsher as the farm grows, and the umber ledger bars one solver from answering for two identities.
